pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'la sœur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sister
   B. the family
   C. the baby
   D. the brother

2. What does 'La télé est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rug is under the table.
   B. The TV is on the table.
   C. Where is the key?
   D. The fridge is in the kitchen.

3. What does 'la table' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the kitchen
   B. the table
   C. the chair
   D. the bedroom

4. Fill in: Dans le salon, il y a un ______. (1 mark)
   A. frigo
   B. lit
   C. canapé
   D. gâteau

5. How do you say 'In the kitchen, there is a fridge.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   B. Voici ma maison.
   C. Mets le livre sur la table.
   D. C'est un lit.

6. What does 'le riz' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. rice
   C. health
   D. juice

7. How do you say 'It is snowing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait chaud.
   B. Il y a des nuages.
   C. Il pleut.
   D. Il neige.

8. How do you say 'the shoulder' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le ventre
   B. l'oreille
   C. le bras
   D. l'épaule

9. How do you say 'Sunday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. dimanche
   B. mercredi
   C. lundi
   D. vendredi

10. What does 'samedi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Thursday
   C. Saturday
   D. Tuesday

11. What does 'bonjour' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hello, good day
   B. Pleased to meet you
   C. good evening
   D. goodbye

12. How do you say 'a cake' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un mois
   B. un anniversaire
   C. un gâteau
   D. un ballon

13. What does 'le jardin' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the garden
   B. the shop
   C. the key
   D. the rug

14. What does 'Voici un cadeau pour toi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is a present for you.
   B. Happy birthday!
   C. My birthday is on 12 May.
   D. I am nine years old.

15. What does 'un mois' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a candle
   B. a birthday
   C. a party
   D. a month

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 30 June.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'Where is the key?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'I stay in the house.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Explain the difference between mon and ma. Give one example of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux oreilles.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — the sister
   la sœur means the sister.

2. B — The TV is on the table.
   La télé est sur la table. means The TV is on the table.

3. B — the table
   la table means the table.

4. C — canapé
   A sofa belongs in the living room.

5. A — Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   In the kitchen, there is a fridge. in French is Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.

6. B — rice
   le riz means rice.

7. D — Il neige.
   It is snowing. in French is Il neige.

8. D — l'épaule
   the shoulder in French is l'épaule.

9. A — dimanche
   Sunday in French is dimanche.

10. C — Saturday
   samedi means Saturday.

11. A — hello, good day
   bonjour means hello, good day.

12. C — un gâteau
   a cake in French is un gâteau.

13. A — the garden
   le jardin means the garden.

14. A — Here is a present for you.
   Voici un cadeau pour toi. means Here is a present for you.

15. D — a month
   un mois means a month.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Où est la clé ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Je reste dans la maison.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mon is used before masculine words, for example mon père. Ma is used before feminine words, for example ma mère.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for each example.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two ears.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
